reference_topic: A Closed-Loop, Microstructure-Informed DIC-FEM Framework for the Real-Time Mitigation of Sintering Stresses in Solid Oxide Fuel Cells through Targeted Creep Activation

material_properties.csv.description: Temperature-dependent bulk properties in the green-to-sintered transition, including porosity and binder content for each layer.

sintering_kinetics.csv.description: Dilatometry-style shrinkage curves for single-layer and bi-layer coupons under multiple sintering schedules.

creep_tests.csv.description: Constant-stress creep responses for green and sintering states, suitable for fitting Norton-Bailey parameters.

elastic_properties.csv.description: Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio as a function of relative density and temperature for all layers.

quality_notes: Values reflect literature ranges and SOFC processing heuristics; treat them as calibrated starting points for FEM.
Calibrate creep parameters (A, n, Q) with in-house tests before design release.
Sintering shrinkage entries assume isotropic contraction without chemical expansion effects.
Use for research and simulation only; do not substitute for qualified material certification.
